items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...didn't one of the Duke Conchets used to play with Bob Long and Conor Mumbo? [INTERVIEWEE] Albert Duke Conchets?

ctx.x: Ernest Kelly played trombone with Bob too. Bob used to change the musician sometimes. I could change Shirley. What about Shelley Du Congdre?
Probably Du Congdre. That's how they do Congdre. That's how they do Congdre. Thank you.
I was wondering, didn't one of the Duke Conchets used to play with Bob Long and Conor Mumbo?
